sections.heading: Axion Solutions
sections.text: Axion Solutions. Senior AI Software Engineer, July 2026 to present. FoodFlow is the multi-tenant food-distribution ERP and the system of record, covering sales, purchasing, inventory, production, finance, and delivery scheduling. Axis is a separate AI product for Studio copilot, data insight, and message drafting. It calls typed tools on FoodFlow, shows a preview, and waits for a person to approve a write. Axis does not own FoodFlow's database. The resume also uses the phrase capital-markets automation for investment and growth workflows. That phrase does not rename FoodFlow.

sections.heading: Axion workflow engine
sections.text: Axion workflow engine. A governed graph platform in the Engine monorepo, separate from FoodFlow. The recipes are startup scouting, investor scouting, and portfolio reporting. Startup scouting searches a list and public profiles, then scores and exports. That export does not send a message. Investor scouting builds a people list. One recipe starts from a saved persona. Portfolio reporting writes company updates. The draft recipe does not send email. A separate recipe emails founders. The record does not call those recipes capital-markets products. Axis can draft on the same host. Axis does not own the Engine database or FoodFlow's data.

sections.heading: Harry the Hirer, Senior AI Engineer
sections.text: Harry the Hirer, Senior AI Engineer. Melbourne, December 2025 to July 2026. Enterprise multi-agent retrieval for event inventory, logistics, and planning. The resume records a pilot effort reduction of about 40 percent and an uptime claim of 99.9 percent. The work includes OCR and document pipelines, and MCP-style access to stock and planning data.

sections.heading: Harry the Hirer, pedigree AI
sections.text: Harry the Hirer, pedigree AI. March 2026 to May 2026. Thoroughbred pedigree AI for the Black Caviar lineage platform, in an ML and data science role.

sections.heading: Mizco
sections.text: Mizco, AI Team Lead. Perth, November 2025 to June 2026. Trust-first platform that turns RFQ text into governed industrial artefacts. The resume records about 50 percent less manual review in the targeted workflows. The build uses constrained JSON, confidence gates, and human review.

sections.heading: Teqar
sections.text: Teqar, AI Development Consultant. Perth, May 2025 to present. Advises B2B clients on AI transformation, from workflow maps to staged delivery plans. The scope includes analytics, vision quality checks, chat, and data pipelines.

sections.heading: Swinburne research
sections.text: Swinburne research. Researcher at Swinburne University of Technology, Melbourne, August 2025 to July 2026. Clinical AI lab of five people. The resume records more than 500,000 curated cases and 86 percent BERTScore on MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MedQuAD. A project line also cites 5 million synthetic cases. Both figures are resume wording, and they are not the same count.

sections.heading: AITC
sections.text: AITC, Senior AI Engineer. June 2025 to November 2025. Industrial LLM, NLP, and OCR assistant. The resume names partner work with Nvidia, HPA, IBM, Juniper, and Cisco Vietnam.

sections.heading: Hai Au Academy
sections.text: Hai Au Academy. AI Software Engineer, August 2025 to October 2025, Binh Duong. HA Manager is the bilingual student-management platform, sold to Hai Au Group. It covers enrollment, placement testing, scheduling, and attendance. The resume records about 35 percent less admin effort.

sections.heading: Pythera
sections.text: Pythera, AI LLM Engineer. January 2025 to September 2025. Clara is a Vietnamese medical language and vision model. The resume records more than 400,000 cases, more than 210,000 imaging studies, recall above 95 percent, and precision above 92 percent on labelled sets. Clara was adopted by 175 Hospital in Ho Chi Minh City. Liam is a contributor, not the sole author.

sections.heading: PopTech
sections.text: PopTech, ML Engineer. Melbourne, May 2025 to July 2025. IoT electricity forecasting. Liam led a four-person team.

sections.heading: Nam A Bank, AI and data
sections.text: Nam A Bank, AI and data. Nam Á Bank, AI and Data Engineer, Ho Chi Minh City, December 2024 to May 2025. OCR, computer vision, and language-model research for passport and remittance documents.

sections.heading: Nam A Bank, software
sections.text: Nam A Bank, software. Nam Á Bank, Software Engineer, April 2023 to June 2024. Banking modules in Java, including Vert.x and Android work.

sections.heading: iNet Solution
sections.text: iNet Solution, Software and Data Scientist. Ho Chi Minh City, April 2024 to March 2025. Sentiment pipeline over news text with Obsei and Transformers.

sections.heading: VietDan, water meters
sections.text: VietDan, water meters. ML Engineer at VietDan JSC, December 2024 to February 2025. Water-meter OCR on more than 10,000 samples. The resume records about 35 percent less manual work. Deployment used Jetson and AWS.

sections.heading: VietDan, cloud
sections.text: VietDan, cloud. Cloud Software Engineer at VietDan JSC, June 2022 to March 2023. AWS IoT and machine-learning services.

sections.heading: Alta Media
sections.text: Alta Media, DevOps Cloud Engineer. May 2022 to January 2023. AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.

sections.heading: Tien Thanh Co
sections.text: Tien Thanh Co, IoT and Software Engineer. Ho Chi Minh City, January 2020 to August 2020.

sections.heading: Swinburne University of Technology
sections.text: Swinburne University of Technology. Bachelor of Software Engineering, Melbourne, 2022 to 2025.

sections.heading: MedSwin
sections.text: MedSwin. Swinburne-funded multi-agent clinical AI. Liam led a five-person lab. Hugging Face org MedSwin hosts the models. The resume says the models were among Australia's most downloaded AI models in November and December 2025. That download rank is resume wording and was not re-counted here.

sections.heading: MedVietAI
sections.text: MedVietAI. Liam is the founder of this non-profit effort toward a sovereign Vietnamese medical language model. The resume says Vietnam's National Data Association sponsored the initiative. The Hugging Face org is MedVietAI.

sections.heading: Codoptic
sections.text: Codoptic. Open-source coding agent and DSL for repository diagrams. Public repository: github.com/Codoptic/Codoptic.

sections.heading: Clinical triage response
sections.text: Clinical triage response. Speech, vision, and language models over MIMIC-IV, with a drone medication-delivery path. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/Triage-LLM-Based. Space: huggingface.co/spaces/khoaliamle/Triage_LLM.

sections.heading: SkyLedge fleet maintenance
sections.text: SkyLedge fleet maintenance. Liam led a four-person capstone team on an OBD-II platform. The resume says SkyLedge Kenya acquired it. The build uses Raspberry Pi telemetry, FastAPI, and fault-prediction models. The servicing-cost figure is an estimate of about 15 percent.

sections.heading: Sall-e
sections.text: Sall-e. Autonomous robot for oceanic garbage collection. The resume says Liam led a software team of five. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/Sall-e.

sections.heading: Golf scorecard scanner
sections.text: Golf scorecard scanner. Sold to VHandicap. The resume records about 15 percent efficiency gain. The stack includes YOLO, VietOCR, and Qwen2.5-VL.

sections.heading: CVA
sections.text: CVA. A career application agent. It plans an application and drafts a CV and a cover letter. A reviewer agent critiques the draft, and a person approves it. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/CVA. Live app: cva-mauve.vercel.app.

sections.heading: WritingJourney
sections.text: WritingJourney. The resume says version 1.5.0 was sold to Hai Au Group. It is an IELTS, PTE, and TOEIC writing coach. It scores a submission, explains the error, and plans the rewrite. A person stays in control of the result.

sections.heading: Roster management
sections.text: Roster management. The resume says this product was sold to MJ Industrial Australia. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/RosterManagement. The resume does not list a separate Android employment at MJ Industrial.

sections.heading: Ericsson 5G digital twin
sections.text: Ericsson 5G digital twin. The resume says Ericsson Vietnam and Swinburne funded this predictive-maintenance platform. It reads tower telemetry, forecasts bandwidth pressure, and detects degradation. The record does not include a deployment count.

sections.heading: ADHD Assistant
sections.text: ADHD Assistant. The resume describes a Nvidia NIM helper for daily routines and planning. It uses voice or text, breaks a task down, and checks progress. The record does not include a user count or a clinical outcome.

sections.heading: MedChat
sections.text: MedChat. The resume calls this a prototype. It is a multilingual medical conversation agent with a planner, specialist routing, and citation checks. The resume does not describe it as a deployed clinical system.

sections.heading: S&P 500 forecast
sections.text: S&P 500 forecast. The resume describes a multi-horizon system. It uses temporal fusion transformers, graph networks, FinBERT on news and SEC filings, and a reinforcement-learning agent for portfolio execution. The data path uses Apache Kafka. The record does not include a return figure.

sections.heading: EstateFolio
sections.text: EstateFolio. The resume describes a price forecast for homes in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi. It models links between districts and reads listing text. The record does not include an error rate.

sections.heading: Public repositories
sections.text: Public repositories. Selected work on github.com/Lelekhoa1812. Prophet is a time-series agent. free-router is an OpenAI-compatible router for Gemini, OpenRouter, and NVIDIA. Survee is an agentic survey tool. stt-studio is local Whisper inference. Quotient takes meeting notes. AgentDiagram turns a diagram into code with more than one agent. Medical-Chatbot-RAG answers general medical questions from retrieved text. Acnt-MCP is an accounting assistant. The record does not include star counts, users, or revenue for these repositories.

sections.heading: Hugging Face models
sections.text: Hugging Face models. Public model cards on huggingface.co/khoaliamle. The names are MNIST numeric recognition, a CTC MNIST model, graffiti detection, Vietnamese passport field recognition, an S&P 500 series, water-meter segmentation, rust detection, garbage detection, garbage classification, driver behaviour from OBD, and fuel efficiency from OBD. The record does not include an accuracy, a dataset size, or a deployment claim for these models.

sections.heading: Skills
sections.text: Skills. Languages: Vietnamese native, English fluent, Mandarin intermediate. The resume groups the stack as agents, retrieval, cloud platforms, software, machine learning, and document AI. Named tools include Python, Java, TypeScript, C#, SQL, React, Next.js, Vue, Node.js, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LlamaIndex, MCP, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Nvidia NIM, vLLM, Docker, Kubernetes, LoRA, OCR, Salesforce Agentforce, Kafka, MLflow, and pgvector.
